The **Missile Launcher** is an explosive heavy gun in *Fallout 76*.

A missile launcher is a weapon capable of being operated by an individual, functioning by launching a rocket-propelled projectile. Missile launchers found in Appalachia are the same model found in the Commonwealth, except with a cleaner appearance.
